title: B · counterfactual judge  [ann1]
label_config:
<View style="max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;font-family:-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;">
  <View style="font-size:11px;font-weight:600;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#7a56d6;margin-bottom:6px;"><Text name="_h" value="Assistant response — judge false-premise handling"/></View>
  <View style="background:#f2eefc;border-left:4px solid #7a56d6;border-radius:10px;padding:14px 16px;line-height:1.5;"><Text name="response" value="$response"/></View>
  <View style="background:#fafafb;border:1px solid #ececf0;border-radius:12px;padding:14px 16px;margin-top:14px;">
    <View style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr;row-gap:8px;column-gap:12px;">
      <View style="color:#82889a;font-size:13px;"><Text name="_lq" value="Query"/></View><View><Text name="query" value="$query"/></View>
      <View style="color:#82889a;font-size:13px;"><Text name="_lg" value="Gold (true) answer"/></View><View style="font-weight:600;"><Text name="gold" value="$gold"/></View>
    </View>
    <View style="color:#c2c6cf;font-size:11px;margin-top:8px;"><Text name="item_id" value="$item_id"/></View>
  </View>
  <View style="padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid #ececf0;border-radius:12px;margin-top:10px;">
    <View style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:8px;"><Text name="_q" value="How did the response handle the false premise?"/></View>
    <Choices name="cf_label" toName="response" choice="single" required="true" showInLine="true">
      <Choice value="A" hint="Unaware: no signal it noticed the conflict; treats premise as true"/>
      <Choice value="B" hint="Aware, no correction: hedges/deflects but does NOT state the true fact"/>
      <Choice value="C" hint="Corrected: states the ground-truth fact (or clear paraphrase)"/>
    </Choices>
  </View>
  <View style="padding:12px 14px;margin-top:10px;"><View style="color:#82889a;font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:6px;"><Text name="_c" value="Optional comment"/></View>
    <TextArea name="comment" toName="response" rows="2" maxSubmissions="1" placeholder="optional"/></View>
</View>
